text:
maria-devex: Heads up — started seeing failures in our onboarding samples when the SDK's package.json switched to an exports map. Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge) resolve to the CJS build and then types are missing. Repro below.

sam-runtime: Can you paste a minimal repro? Which sample app?

maria-devex: sample/nextjs-edge on main. Steps:
1) yarn
2) next dev
3) hit /api/llm
Error shows `TypeError: import(...).default is not a function` and TS can't find typings.

maria-devex: package.json (SDK):
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "dist/cjs/index.js"
    }
  }
}
```

jenna-sdk: hmm — edge bundlers often prefer the `module`/`import` field but Cloudflare Workers have custom resolver. Could be the bundler picking `require` fallback.

lee-ml: Also seeing `dist/types` not included in npm tarball for some versions — that would explain missing typings.

sam-runtime: @jenna-sdk can we add an `edge` conditional export? e.g.
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "edge": "dist/edge/index.js",
    "import": "dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "dist/cjs/index.js"
  }
}
```

jenna-sdk: That helps but only if bundler supports the conditional. Another pragmatic fix: add top-level `browser` -> `dist/esm/index.js` or `engines` hint.

tariq-frontend: Workaround I used: force ESM via webpack alias: `resolve.alias['@redwood/sdk'] = path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm')` — ugly but works for now :grimacing:

ci-bot: Integration tests failing: tests/nextjs-edge/onboarding.test.js -> import error (exit code 1)

maria-devex: Proposal: 1) patch release to include types in tarball 2) add `edge` conditional export for next patch 3) update docs + sample apps to pin resolver. I'll open GH issue and assign to eng-runtime + sdk. :+1:

sam-runtime: Sounds good. If someone can drop the failing packument/link I'll add a quick test to our edge CI.

maria-devex: I opened https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/412 — added repro and CI logs.

jenna-sdk: thx — I'll prep the patch and include a fallback `exports['.']['default']` entry to help older bundlers.
